<script>
(function () {
  try {
    if (!window.fetch) return;

    // ===== Config =====
    var UID_COOKIE = "gn_uid";
    var UID_DAYS = 365;

    // Stape Click ID Restorer backup param (Google Ads Final URL suffix: qwerty={gclid})
    var BACKUP_GCLID_PARAM = "qwerty";

    // ===== Helpers (ES5-safe: no block-scoped function declarations) =====
    var nowIso = function () { return new Date().toISOString(); };
    var safeSlice = function (v, n) {
      v = (v || "").toString().trim();
      return v.length > n ? v.slice(0, n) : v;
    };

    var getCookie = function (name) {
      var m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp("(^| )" + name + "=([^;]+)"));
      return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[2]) : "";
    };

    var setCookie = function (name, value, days) {
      var d = new Date();
      d.setTime(d.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      document.cookie =
        name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) +
        "; expires=" + d.toUTCString() +
        "; path=/; SameSite=Lax";
    };

    // Session cookie with 30-minute inactivity TTL (refreshed on each stitch fire).
    var setSessionCookie = function (name, value) {
      if (!value) return;
      document.cookie =
        name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) +
        "; max-age=1800; path=/; SameSite=Lax";
    };

    var expireCookie = function (name) {
      document.cookie =
        name + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/; SameSite=Lax";
    };

    var uuidv4 = function () {
      return ([1e7] + -1e3 + -4e3 + -8e3 + -1e11).replace(/[018]/g, function (c) {
        return (c ^ crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(1))[0] & 15 >> c / 4).toString(16);
      });
    };

    var getLS = function (k) { try { return localStorage.getItem(k) || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; } };
    var setLS = function (k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch (e) {} };

    // ===== 1) Ensure stitch id cookie =====
    var gn_uid = getCookie(UID_COOKIE);
    if (!gn_uid) {
      gn_uid = uuidv4();
      setCookie(UID_COOKIE, gn_uid, UID_DAYS);
    }

    // ===== 2) Capture first-touch attribution (only once) =====
    var qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search);

    var sanitizeMetaId = function (v) {
      v = (v || "").toString().trim();
      if (!v) return "";
      if (!/^[0-9]{1,32}$/.test(v)) return "";
      return v;
    };

    var cand = {
      utm_source: qs.get("utm_source") || "",
      utm_medium: qs.get("utm_medium") || "",
      utm_campaign: qs.get("utm_campaign") || "",
      utm_content: qs.get("utm_content") || "",
      utm_term: qs.get("utm_term") || "",

      // Click IDs
      gclid: (qs.get("gclid") || qs.get(BACKUP_GCLID_PARAM) || ""),
      gbraid: qs.get("gbraid") || "",
      wbraid: qs.get("wbraid") || "",
      msclkid: qs.get("msclkid") || "",
      fbclid: qs.get("fbclid") || "",
      ttclid: qs.get("ttclid") || "",

      // Deterministic Meta IDs (authoritative). Names are diagnostic only.
      gn_meta_campaign_id: sanitizeMetaId(qs.get("gn_meta_campaign_id")),
      gn_meta_adset_id: sanitizeMetaId(qs.get("gn_meta_adset_id")),
      gn_meta_ad_id: sanitizeMetaId(qs.get("gn_meta_ad_id")),
      gn_meta_campaign_name: safeSlice(qs.get("gn_meta_campaign_name") || "", 200),
      gn_meta_adset_name: safeSlice(qs.get("gn_meta_adset_name") || "", 200),
      gn_meta_ad_name: safeSlice(qs.get("gn_meta_ad_name") || "", 200)
    };

    // Referrer hostname only (avoid storing full URL)
    var ref = "";
    try {
      if (document.referrer) {
        var r = new URL(document.referrer);
        if (r.hostname && r.hostname !== location.hostname) ref = safeSlice(r.hostname, 200);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    var hasAny = !!(cand.utm_source || cand.utm_medium || cand.utm_campaign || cand.gclid || cand.msclkid || cand.fbclid || cand.ttclid || cand.gn_meta_campaign_id || cand.gn_meta_adset_id || cand.gn_meta_ad_id || ref);

    var FT_KEY = "gn_first_touch_v1";
    var ftRaw = getLS(FT_KEY);
    var ft = null;
    try { ft = ftRaw ? JSON.parse(ftRaw) : null; } catch (e) { ft = null; }

    if (!ft && hasAny) {
      ft = {
        ts: nowIso(),
        landing_path: safeSlice(location.pathname, 200),
        referrer: ref || ""
      };

      if (cand.utm_source) ft.utm_source = safeSlice(cand.utm_source, 200);
      if (cand.utm_medium) ft.utm_medium = safeSlice(cand.utm_medium, 200);
      if (cand.utm_campaign) ft.utm_campaign = safeSlice(cand.utm_campaign, 200);
      if (cand.utm_content) ft.utm_content = safeSlice(cand.utm_content, 200);
      if (cand.utm_term) ft.utm_term = safeSlice(cand.utm_term, 200);

      if (cand.gclid) ft.gclid = safeSlice(cand.gclid, 200);
      if (cand.gbraid) ft.gbraid = safeSlice(cand.gbraid, 200);
      if (cand.wbraid) ft.wbraid = safeSlice(cand.wbraid, 200);
      if (cand.msclkid) ft.msclkid = safeSlice(cand.msclkid, 200);
      if (cand.fbclid) ft.fbclid = safeSlice(cand.fbclid, 200);
      if (cand.ttclid) ft.ttclid = safeSlice(cand.ttclid, 200);

      if (cand.gn_meta_campaign_id) ft.gn_first_meta_campaign_id = cand.gn_meta_campaign_id;
      if (cand.gn_meta_adset_id) ft.gn_first_meta_adset_id = cand.gn_meta_adset_id;
      if (cand.gn_meta_ad_id) ft.gn_first_meta_ad_id = cand.gn_meta_ad_id;
      if (cand.gn_meta_campaign_name) ft.gn_first_meta_campaign_name = cand.gn_meta_campaign_name;
      if (cand.gn_meta_adset_name) ft.gn_first_meta_adset_name = cand.gn_meta_adset_name;
      if (cand.gn_meta_ad_name) ft.gn_first_meta_ad_name = cand.gn_meta_ad_name;

      setLS(FT_KEY, JSON.stringify(ft));
    }

    var firstMetaCampaign = ft
      ? (ft.gn_first_meta_campaign_id || ft.gn_meta_campaign_id || "")
      : "";
    var firstMetaAdset = ft
      ? (ft.gn_first_meta_adset_id || ft.gn_meta_adset_id || "")
      : "";
    var firstMetaAd = ft
      ? (ft.gn_first_meta_ad_id || ft.gn_meta_ad_id || "")
      : "";
    var firstMetaCampaignName = ft
      ? (ft.gn_first_meta_campaign_name || ft.gn_meta_campaign_name || "")
      : "";
    var firstMetaAdsetName = ft
      ? (ft.gn_first_meta_adset_name || ft.gn_meta_adset_name || "")
      : "";
    var firstMetaAdName = ft
      ? (ft.gn_first_meta_ad_name || ft.gn_meta_ad_name || "")
      : "";

    // ===== 2b) Current-session Meta IDs (30-minute inactivity TTL) =====
    // Typed BQ meta_* and GA4/DT gn_meta_* must be THIS click, not first-touch.
    var SS_KEY = "gn_session_meta_v1";
    var META_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
    var nowMs = Date.now();
    var sessionMeta = null;
    try {
      sessionMeta = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(SS_KEY) || "null");
    } catch (e) {
      sessionMeta = null;
    }
    if (cand.gn_meta_campaign_id || cand.gn_meta_adset_id || cand.gn_meta_ad_id) {
      sessionMeta = {
        gn_meta_campaign_id: cand.gn_meta_campaign_id || "",
        gn_meta_adset_id: cand.gn_meta_adset_id || "",
        gn_meta_ad_id: cand.gn_meta_ad_id || "",
        last_seen: nowMs
      };
      try { sessionStorage.setItem(SS_KEY, JSON.stringify(sessionMeta)); } catch (e) {}
    } else if (sessionMeta) {
      var lastSeen = Number(sessionMeta.last_seen || 0);
      if (!lastSeen || (nowMs - lastSeen) > META_TTL_MS) {
        sessionMeta = null;
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem(SS_KEY); } catch (e) {}
      } else {
        sessionMeta.last_seen = nowMs;
        try { sessionStorage.setItem(SS_KEY, JSON.stringify(sessionMeta)); } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
    if (sessionMeta && (sessionMeta.gn_meta_campaign_id || sessionMeta.gn_meta_adset_id || sessionMeta.gn_meta_ad_id)) {
      if (sessionMeta.gn_meta_campaign_id) setSessionCookie("gn_meta_campaign_id", sessionMeta.gn_meta_campaign_id);
      else expireCookie("gn_meta_campaign_id");
      if (sessionMeta.gn_meta_adset_id) setSessionCookie("gn_meta_adset_id", sessionMeta.gn_meta_adset_id);
      else expireCookie("gn_meta_adset_id");
      if (sessionMeta.gn_meta_ad_id) setSessionCookie("gn_meta_ad_id", sessionMeta.gn_meta_ad_id);
      else expireCookie("gn_meta_ad_id");
    } else {
      expireCookie("gn_meta_campaign_id");
      expireCookie("gn_meta_adset_id");
      expireCookie("gn_meta_ad_id");
    }

    // ===== 2c) Mirror first-touch into cookies (first-write only) =====
    // sGTM BQ maps gclid/fbclid from Event Data gn_gclid / gn_fbclid.
    // Returning visitors who already have localStorage get cookies on this run.
    // Meta first-touch cookies are gn_first_meta_* — never gn_meta_*.
    if (ft) {
      var ftCookies = [
        ["gn_utm_source", ft.utm_source],
        ["gn_utm_medium", ft.utm_medium],
        ["gn_utm_campaign", ft.utm_campaign],
        ["gn_utm_content", ft.utm_content],
        ["gn_utm_term", ft.utm_term],
        ["gn_gclid", ft.gclid],
        ["gn_gbraid", ft.gbraid],
        ["gn_wbraid", ft.wbraid],
        ["gn_msclkid", ft.msclkid],
        ["gn_fbclid", ft.fbclid],
        ["gn_ttclid", ft.ttclid],
        ["gn_first_meta_campaign_id", firstMetaCampaign],
        ["gn_first_meta_adset_id", firstMetaAdset],
        ["gn_first_meta_ad_id", firstMetaAd]
      ];
      var ci;
      for (ci = 0; ci < ftCookies.length; ci++) {
        var ck = ftCookies[ci];
        if (ck[1] && !getCookie(ck[0])) setCookie(ck[0], safeSlice(ck[1], 200), UID_DAYS);
      }
    }

    // ===== 3) Build Shopify order attributes =====
    var attrs = { gn_uid: safeSlice(gn_uid, 64) };

    if (ft) {
      if (ft.ts) attrs.gn_first_touch_ts = safeSlice(ft.ts, 40);
      if (ft.landing_path) attrs.gn_landing_path = safeSlice(ft.landing_path, 200);
      if (ft.referrer) attrs.gn_referrer = safeSlice(ft.referrer, 200);

      if (ft.utm_source) attrs.gn_utm_source = safeSlice(ft.utm_source, 200);
      if (ft.utm_medium) attrs.gn_utm_medium = safeSlice(ft.utm_medium, 200);
      if (ft.utm_campaign) attrs.gn_utm_campaign = safeSlice(ft.utm_campaign, 200);
      if (ft.utm_content) attrs.gn_utm_content = safeSlice(ft.utm_content, 200);
      if (ft.utm_term) attrs.gn_utm_term = safeSlice(ft.utm_term, 200);

      if (ft.gclid) attrs.gn_gclid = safeSlice(ft.gclid, 200);
      if (ft.gbraid) attrs.gn_gbraid = safeSlice(ft.gbraid, 200);
      if (ft.wbraid) attrs.gn_wbraid = safeSlice(ft.wbraid, 200);
      if (ft.msclkid) attrs.gn_msclkid = safeSlice(ft.msclkid, 200);
      if (ft.fbclid) attrs.gn_fbclid = safeSlice(ft.fbclid, 200);
      if (ft.ttclid) attrs.gn_ttclid = safeSlice(ft.ttclid, 200);

      if (firstMetaCampaign) attrs.gn_first_meta_campaign_id = safeSlice(firstMetaCampaign, 32);
      if (firstMetaAdset) attrs.gn_first_meta_adset_id = safeSlice(firstMetaAdset, 32);
      if (firstMetaAd) attrs.gn_first_meta_ad_id = safeSlice(firstMetaAd, 32);
      if (firstMetaCampaignName) attrs.gn_first_meta_campaign_name = safeSlice(firstMetaCampaignName, 200);
      if (firstMetaAdsetName) attrs.gn_first_meta_adset_name = safeSlice(firstMetaAdsetName, 200);
      if (firstMetaAdName) attrs.gn_first_meta_ad_name = safeSlice(firstMetaAdName, 200);
    }

    // ===== 4) Write to Shopify cart attributes (non-blocking) =====
    // Avoid spamming /cart/update.js
    var SENT_KEY = "gn_cart_attrs_sent_hash_v1";
    var payload = JSON.stringify(attrs);

    // quick stable hash (string-based; good enough for "did it change?")
    var hash = "";
    try {
      var i;
      for (i = 0; i < payload.length; i++) {
        hash = (hash + payload.charCodeAt(i).toString(16));
        if (hash.length > 2048) hash = hash.slice(-2048);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    if (getLS(SENT_KEY) === hash) return;

    fetch("/cart/update.js", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json" },
      credentials: "same-origin",
      keepalive: true,
      body: JSON.stringify({ attributes: attrs })
    }).then(function () {
      setLS(SENT_KEY, hash);
    }).catch(function () {});

  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>
